title: Manager
description:
**Job Title**

Manager

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

We are looking for an Manager, Retail Leasing to join our Retail Team in Vizag. In this team-based position, you will need a desire for success in the Retail Leasing & Sales Business with new prospects and ability to handle complex conversations with owners, C-Suite, and high level corporate real estate decision makers. Clients and prospects include local companies with single locations up to global corporations with many diverse geographic locations. Your working knowledge of any major vertical industry will be very helpful. In addition to sales, you will be involved in all aspects of the evaluation, negotiation, and successful delivery of real estate services.

**What this job involves:**

* Execute new business development by participating in cold calling, converting calls to meetings, new business wins
* Grow client relationships by attending client meetings, conducting property tours, developing follow-up materials for clients (e.g., lease comparisons, market overviews, property summary books, prospect or client presentations & proposals), providing clients with industry and market specific information as it relates to their business & maintain contact information on prospects
* Maintain and update the Retail Brokerage Team’s market research database
* Support client transaction process by reviewing quantitative location data, legal documents, working with sophisticated Excel-based analytical tools including macro-enabled financial models and financial analysis, including cash flow projections, valuation models, & sensitivity analyses
* Work with research and other team members to compile market information and statistics on the local retail real estate market to assemble materials on market fundamentals, ownership, tenants & economic analysis
* Actively participate in the brokerage team by attending meetings & weekly sales updates, conducting market research to support presentation materials, publications, reports & deliverables & use in completion of market surveys, data analyses
* Contribute to designated local market research requests: market snapshots, market overviews, quarterly market decks, topic specific research to support pitches and brokerage opportunities

**Interested? An ideal candidate would need to have the following qualifications:**

**Required**

* 5+ years in retail brokerage business with a demonstrable success in high level of transaction closures
* Strong computer orientation & proficiency with Microsoft Office including Excel, PowerPoint & Word, ability to analyze qualitative & quantitative information & translate into strategic deliverables
* Excellent interpersonal, customer service, time management, organizational, written & verbal communication skills, ability to be proactive & adapt in a fast-paced work environment
* Project management capabilities, including multi-tasking, prioritization, deadline management, & the ability to work both independently & with a team
* A desire to work within a diverse, collaborative, and driven professional environment with a positive, professional attitude

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, real estate or related field

**Location:** On-Site

**Why join Cushman & Wakefield?**

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from it.

* Being part of a growing global company.
* Career development and promotion within culture.

We're committed to providing a work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.  
We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

  
INCO: “Cushman & Wakefield”

title: Chief Officer – Taxation
description:
1. **Overall Roles & Responsibilities**

As
**Chief Officer-Taxation**
, the person will be responsible for managing Indirect Tax (GST) and Direct Tax (Income Tax) compliances for V-Guard Industries Limited and its subsidiaries. The incumbent will ensure timely and accurate tax compliance, support audits and assessments, Tax MIS, keep a tab on tax developments, provide tax advisory support to business teams, and coordinate with external stakeholders and tax authorities.

**GST compliance, litigation and advisory (primary)**

* Play an important role in Indirect Tax governance
* Preparation and filing of periodic GST returns for the company
* Prepare & review GST & ITC reconciliations between books of accounts and GST portal data
* Prepare/Review submission of responses to GST department intimations, notices, investigations and audits
* Liaise with branches, plants, business teams and consultants during GST audits, assessments and litigation
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on GST implications in business transactions and operational matters
* Support implementation of GST process improvements and ERP changes arising from amendments in GST laws

**Income-tax compliance, litigation and advisory (secondary)**

* Play an important role in Direct Tax governance
* Support in compliance with TDS provisions
* Support in filing of income-tax returns for the company and group entities
* Assist in preparation and timely filing of Statement of Financial Transactions (SFT)
* Reconcile TDS, advance tax, self-assessment tax and tax credits with books and income-tax portal records
* Assist in preparation of submissions and responses to queries from Income-Tax department
* Monitor changes in direct tax laws and evaluate their impact on business operations

1. **Qualifications / Knowledge / Skills Requires**

* CA with 2 to 5 years of experience
* Experience in Direct / Indirect tax related roles
* Experience in working on SAP preferred
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong stakeholder management and risk evaluation experience

title: Risk Platforms-EGRC-Workiva-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY - GDS Consulting**
–
**GRC Technology – EnterpriseGRC – Workiva - Senior**
As EY GDS Consulting Senior, you’ll contribute technically to GRC Technology client engagements and internal projects. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for GRC Professionals with expertise in Workiva Platform and Workiva GRC solutions to join our international network of GRC Technology professionals helping clients implement technology solutions that support governance, risk management, compliance, internal controls, audit, and regulatory reporting. The individual will assist GRC Leads and Solution Architects in designing Workiva-based solutions, creating proof of concepts, assessing technology feasibility, and implementing scalable GRC and compliance programs.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a leading consulting practice while playing a key role in expanding our Workiva service offerings globally.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and client stakeholders to understand business requirements and design optimal Workiva solutions.
* Map customer requirements to Workiva capabilities and recommend leading practices for GRC, Internal Audit, SOX Compliance, ESG Reporting, and Regulatory Compliance programs.
* Configure and implement Workiva solutions including:
* SOX/Internal Controls Management
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
* Internal Audit Management
* Compliance Management
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Third-Party Risk Management
* Policy Management
* Design Workiva data models, reporting structures, workflows, and user experiences to support business processes.
* Configure Workiva workflows, task management, certifications, issue management, risk registers, controls, testing programs, and reporting dashboards.
* Drive automation, standardization, and process optimization across risk and compliance functions.
* Develop and maintain Workiva reports, linked documents, dashboards, questionnaires, assessments, and analytics solutions.
* Collaborate with client and technical teams to integrate Workiva with ERP, HR, Identity Management, and other enterprise systems.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including user story refinement, effort estimation, and sprint planning.
* Conduct requirements workshops, solution demonstrations, showback sessions, UAT support, and knowledge transfer sessions.
* Perform testing, quality assurance, and defect resolution activities.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to project teams and mentor junior resources.
* Stay current with Workiva platform enhancements, GRC trends, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.
* Assist regional teams in RFP responses, solution proposals, effort estimations, and client presentations.
* Develop and maintain productive client relationships and contribute to customer success.
* Ensure timely delivery of assigned tasks while adhering to project quality standards and organizational policies.
* Support project leadership in planning, estimation, delivery governance, and stakeholder management activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to translate complex risk and compliance requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience creating solution design documents, process flows, and implementation artifacts.
* Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a strong quality culture.
* Ability to mentor team members and support capability-building initiatives.

**To qualify for the role, you must have-**

* 3 to 8+ years of relevant experience in GRC, Internal Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, or Governance Technology implementations.
* Experience working on 3 to 5 end-to-end Workiva implementation engagements.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
* Workiva Internal Controls Management (SOX)
* Workiva Risk Management
* Workiva Internal Audit Management
* Workiva Compliance Programs
* ESG Reporting
* Regulatory Reporting
* Strong understanding of:
* SOX Compliance
* Internal Controls Frameworks
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Internal Audit Processes
* Regulatory Compliance
* Information Security Governance
* Experience facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, configuring solutions, and supporting UAT.
* Experience creating and maintaining functional and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of reporting, dashboarding, workflow design, and data management within Workiva.
* Experience in client-facing consulting engagements and stakeholder management.

**Ideally, you should also have**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional certifications such as:

- CPA
- CIA
- CISA
- CRISC
- Workiva Certifications

* Experience with large-scale transformation or compliance programs.
* Understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Experience working with consulting firms, system integrators, or Big 4 organizations.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as:

- AuditBoard
- Archer
- ServiceNow IRM
- MetricStream
- Diligent HighBond
- SAP GRC

* Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as:

- Power BI
- Tableau
- Alteryx
- Snowflake

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: TC - CS - Data Protection and Privacy - Purview - Manager
description:

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – Microsoft Purview**
to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labelling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management**
. The candidate should also possess sound understanding of
**DSPM for AI and Data Governance.**
The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**

* Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
* Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
* Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
* Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.

**Data Classification & Labelling**

* Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labelling, and Mandatory Labelling strategies.
* Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
* Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.

**DSPM for AI**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI policies, assessments, and risk monitoring.
* Investigate AI-related data exposure, oversharing, and compliance risks.
* Develop AI governance use cases focused on responsible AI adoption and data protection.
* Deliver AI risk insights, posture reports, and executive dashboards.

**Data Governance**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities and services.
* Drive data discovery, classification, cataloguing, and lineage initiatives.
* Develop governance frameworks for data quality, ownership, compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Produce governance metrics, compliance reports, and executive dashboards.

**Insider Risk Management**

* Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
* Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
* Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
* Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.

**Data Lifecycle Management**

* Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
* Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.

**Consulting & Delivery**

* Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
* Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
* Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview Data Security and Compliance solutions.
* Expertise in:

+ Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
+ Sensitivity Labels and Information Protection
+ Data Classification and Governance
+ Insider Risk Management
+ DSPM for AI
+ Data Governance
+ Data Lifecycle Management (desirable)
+ Records Management (desirable)
+ Communication Compliance (desirable)
+ eDiscovery (desirable)

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, and data privacy requirements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Security ecosystem integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud security and Microsoft 365 architecture.

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into security controls and governance policies.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Consulting mindset with client-facing experience.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 9+ years of experience in data protection, information security, compliance, or Microsoft 365 security technologies.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent analytical skills and knowledge of data analytics methods
* Demonstrated leadership abilities
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills

**Relevant certifications preferred:**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator (SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate (MS-500)
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills.
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, CIPPE/M, Technical (Vendor) Certifications.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

description:
The Senior Legal Manager oversees the NBFC's complete legal function, providing strategic advisory to management on corporate governance, transaction execution, loan structuring, dispute resolution, and asset recovery. 1 . Transactional Documentation & Deal Structuring

* **Draft and vet** credit-related documents, including Facility Agreements, Loan Hypothecation forms, Co-lending agreements, and Escrow arrangements.

* **Drive asset recovery frameworks**, deploying legal instruments across SARFAESI Act, Debt Recovery Tribunals (DRT), Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act (Cheque Bounce), and corporate arbitrations.

* **Manage title search reviews** and enforcement policies for asset-backed portfolios (e.g., Loan Against Property or Construction Finance).

* **Minimize legal risk** in new product rollouts, ensuring full adherence to the Fair Practices Code (FPC), KYC guidelines, and Data Protection mandates.
* **Collaborate with Internal Audit** and Compliance teams to map, remediate, and report operational risk vulnerabilities.

4. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* **Manage relationships** with cross-functional business heads, credit risk managers, and treasury leads.
* **Supervise, train, and mentor** junior legal officers, implementing tech automation (e.g., contract lifecycle management tools) to speed up turnaround times.

description:
**Role Overview**
The Manager / Senior Manager – Foreign Trade India will be responsible for leading and managing all Foreign Trade, Customs, Export Control, and Trade Compliance activities across MAHLE India operations. The role will ensure complete compliance with customs laws, DGFT regulations, export control legislation, and international trade requirements while optimizing duty structures, leveraging government incentive schemes, and supporting business growth through efficient trade processes.
  
  
The incumbent will serve as the key interface with Customs Authorities, DGFT, Government Agencies, Logistics Service Providers, and internal stakeholders to drive compliance, cost optimization, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Your Contribution**
**Foreign Trade & Customs Management**

* Lead all customs and foreign trade activities across MAHLE India entities.
* Ensure legally compliant import and export operations at the lowest lawful cost.
* Manage customs clearance processes, import/export documentation, tariff classification, and valuation activities.
* Drive optimization of customs duties through applicable schemes and regulatory provisions.
* Coordinate with Customs Authorities, DGFT, Chambers of Commerce, and other government bodies.
* Manage customs brokers, consultants, and logistics service providers.
* Ensure robust and compliant inbound and outbound customs processes.

**Export Control & Trade Compliance**
  
  

* Ensure compliance with global and local Export Control Regulations.
* Manage Export Control classifications for products, technology transfers, and software.
* Implement and govern:

+ Sanctioned Party Screening
+ Embargo Country Checks
+ End-use Verification
+ Export Authorization Requirements

* Conduct periodic audits and compliance reviews across locations.
* Provide guidance to business functions on export control obligations.
* Possess authority to stop transactions or exports that violate export control regulations.

**Government Incentives & Trade Programs**
  
  

* Drive implementation and effective utilization of government export incentive schemes.
* Manage:

+ RoDTEP
+ Duty Drawback Schemes
+ AIR and Brand Rate Schemes
+ Section 74 Refund Claims

* Ensure timely claim filing and maximize incentive realization with minimum pendency.
* Support implementation of AEO, MOOWR, and similar trade facilitation programs.

**Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* Monitor changes in customs, DGFT, and international trade regulations.
* Evaluate regulatory impact on business operations and advise management accordingly.
* Handle legal notices, investigations, summons, SCNs, DRI and SIIB matters.
* Mitigate customs and trade compliance risks through robust internal controls.
* Lead external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.

Process Improvement & Digitalization
  
  

* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of foreign trade processes.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Support digitalization initiatives and automation of trade compliance activities.
* Define regional requirements and integrate them into global standards.
* Develop sustainable solutions for customs and trade-related challenges.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with Purchase, Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Legal, IT, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the primary liaison for trade compliance matters with authorities and external agencies.
* Support strategic business initiatives involving international trade activities.
* Regularly communicate compliance status, risks, and improvement initiatives to management.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and mentor the Foreign Trade team.
* Build organizational capability in customs and export control compliance.
* Conduct training and awareness programs across business functions.
* Promote a culture of compliance and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance to plant Export Control Officers and other compliance stakeholders.

**Your Experience And Qualification**

* 10+ years of experience in Foreign Trade, Customs, Export Control, and Trade Compliance.
* Strong experience managing import/export operations in a manufacturing environment.

**Expertise In**
  
  


* Customs Laws and Procedures
* DGFT Regulations
* Export Control Legislation (EU, US and India)
* Origin Management and Free Trade Agreements
* Government Export Incentive Schemes
* Experience handling customs investigations, audits, legal notices, and regulatory interactions.
* Knowledge of AEO, MOOWR, and other trade facilitation programs preferred.
* Strong exposure to working with government authorities and regulatory agencies.
* Proven people leadership and stakeholder management capability.
* Graduate or Post-Graduate in Foreign Trade, International Business, Commerce, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related disciplines.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
**About Us**
**Job title**
Legal Counsel
  
  
**Department**
Finance
  
  
**Reports to**
Chief Financial Officer (co-founder)
  
  
**Location**
Pune, India – full-time, work from office

7+ years, with at least 4 in-house
  
  
**Qualification**
LLB (LLM a plus), enrolled to practice in India
  
  
**The Role**
You will serve as Legal Counsel for the entire Anchanto group, working directly with the CFO and the leadership team. As the company’s sole in-house lawyer, you will independently handle most legal matters and work closely with Sales, Finance, HR, Product / Engineering, Security, and country teams. The quality, practicality, and speed of your advice will have a direct impact on the business.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how a larger company’s legal function operates and is comfortable bringing that experience into a hands-on role without a legal team behind them.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Contracts and Commercial

Â· Own and maintain contract templates across every region in which Anchanto operates, including APAC, the EU, the UK, the US, India, and the Middle East. Templates include customer agreements, statements of work (SOWs), partner agreements, reseller contracts, and supplier contracts.
  
  
Â· Draft, review, and negotiate enterprise contracts, and participate as part of the deal team for the company’s largest customers. Help shape legal terms for evolving commercial models, including multi-year agreements, usage-based pricing, and service levels for work performed by agents.
  
  
Â· Maintain a central repository of signed agreements that is organised, searchable, and up to date, with key dates and contractual obligations tracked.
  
  

* Compliance and Risk

Â· Help ensure compliance with applicable data protection and privacy laws, including GDPR, PDPA, India’s DPDP Act, and other relevant requirements. Support customer security audits and certifications such as ISO 27001.
  
  
Â· Partner with Security, IT, HR, Product / Engineering, and other teams to develop and update policies, and deliver practical training that employees can understand and apply.
  
  
Â· Identify legal risks early in deals and projects, advise stakeholders on practical ways to manage or contain those risks, and handle customer and contract disputes, including intellectual property matters.
  
  
Â· Ensure the company’s insurance arrangements align with decisions made by management.
  
  

* AI in Legal and in Our Business

Â· Use Claude and other AI tools in day-to-day legal work to review contracts, check them against the company’s playbook, search the agreement repository, and prepare first drafts.
  
  
Â· Contribute to building automation and AI-agent initiatives for the legal function, developing workflows that improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate legal review and oversight.
  
  
Â· Advise the Product team on legal issues relating to Anchanto’s own AI offering, including customer data use, liability, intellectual property, and the terms governing AI agents operating within customers’ systems.
  
  
**What You Bring**
Â· 7+ years of legal experience, including at least 4 years in-house at a software, SaaS, or technology company, ideally with 500+ employees or equivalent scale. Previous law-firm experience is a plus.
  
  
Â· Strong command of commercial and technology contracts, including SaaS, licensing, data processing, liability, and intellectual property, with experience negotiating directly with enterprise customers’ legal counsel.
  
  
Â· Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, PDPA, and India’s DPDP Act, as well as security and compliance audits. Exposure to Singapore, EU, and US law is an advantage.
  
  
Â· Practical fluency with AI tools: already using Claude or a similar tool in daily legal work, able to explain where it performs well and where its output needs to be checked, and motivated to build workflows rather than wait for a tool.
  
  
Â· Comfortable working as a sole contributor—drafting documents, managing filings, and handling both strategic and administrative legal work independently.
  
  
Â· Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to explain what is risky, what is acceptable, and what the company can sign, while providing timely advice when a deal is moving.
  
  
Â· Clear, concise written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with the CFO, CEO, and senior customers.
  
  
Â· Based in Pune and comfortable working from the office.
  
  
**Role**
**What This Role Is Not — and Why Join**
This role is not suited to someone who wants primarily to manage a legal team, review and delegate work, or send every contract to external counsel. It is not a back-office role: you will be involved in decisions about pricing, customer commitments, and business growth.
  
  
In return, you will have direct access to the founders and leadership team, genuine ownership of a function at a company undergoing a major shift, and the opportunity to build an AI-first legal practice.
  
  
**Benefits**
****Why Join Anchanto****
At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.
  
  

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

The role will ensure that project contracts are commercially robust, contractual obligations are actively managed, changes and claims are controlled, and commercial risks are identified and mitigated to protect project returns and delivery timelines.This is a high-visibility position with direct exposure to senior management, the Steering Committee and international shareholders. It suits a commercially minded finance professional who is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance, contracts and operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
Strategic decision support
  
  

* Support the management in strategic decision-making through robust commercial analysis, scenario modelling and clear recommendations.
* Evaluate options relating to financing, offtake, O&M, curtailment, merchant exposure, refinancing, asset optimisation and potential M&A / divestment, and articulate trade-offs and risks.

Board and Steering Committee material
  
  

* Prepare periodic reporting materials, SteerCo decks and supporting papers, consolidating inputs from Finance, Operations, Legal, Construction / Technical and external advisors.
* Ensure board material is accurate, concise, decision-oriented and delivered on time; track and close out SteerCo action items.

Contract management
  
  

* Perform the commercial evaluation of new contracts and contract amendments
* Assess commercial exposure, liquidated damages, claims, change orders, delay and performance entitlements; quantify financial impact for negotiation strategy.
* Support the evaluation, response and management of commercial disputes and notices (including claims, change in law, and termination-related notices) in coordination with Legal and external counsel.
* Maintain a contract register, key dates and obligations tracker.

Quarterly fair value
  
  

* Determine and recommend key valuation assumptions (e.g. power price and curtailment, generation / P50-P90, opex, inflation, discount rate, tax, and macro inputs) in line with the valuation policy
* Perform quality assurance on the financial model and results, including reconciliation to prior quarter, variance and sensitivity analysis, and review with auditors / valuers where required.
* Prepare and present the quarterly fair value reporting material to the management.

Budget and liquidity management
  
  

* Monitor Estimate at Completion (EAC) versus approved budget; analyse variances, forecast cost-to-complete and flag overruns early with proposed mitigations.
* Own the sources and uses of funds, rolling cash-flow forecasts and funding requirements (equity, debt drawdowns, working capital), and liaise with Treasury / Finance and the Sponsor on funding calls.

Risk management
  
  

* Maintain the project risk register: identify, quantify, assign owners and track mitigations across commercial, financial, construction, operational, regulatory and counterparty risks.
* Escalate key risks and present risk updates to management and the SteerCo.

Monitoring of financing, offtake and operations
  
  

* Financing: track debt covenants, compliance certificates, drawdowns, hedging, DSRA / reserve requirements and lender relationships.
* Offtake: monitor PPA terms and performance, tariff, payment and receivables, curtailment, deviation settlement and grid / counterparty developments.
* Operations: track generation, availability, O&M performance, opex versus budget and key operational KPIs, and translate them into commercial impact.
* Keep abreast of regulatory and policy developments in the Indian power sector (CERC / SERC / MNRE, open access, transmission charges, RPO / GNA, etc.).

**You**
You should have a Chartered Accountant (CA), CFA, MBA, BE from a reputed institute, or an equivalent professional qualification, with 8–10 years of relevant experience in commercial, finance, or project management roles, within the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors. Practical experience with the construction and/or operation of large-scale wind, solar, or hybrid projects in India is required. You should also have experience in valuation and fair-value reporting, financial modelling, and investor or board reporting, with prior exposure to an international sponsor, private equity/infrastructure fund, or Big 4/advisory firm.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Commercial acumen and structured judgment; ability to form a view and recommend a decision.
* Clear and effective communication, both written and spoken;
* High attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple deadlines and recurring reporting cycles.
* Integrity, discretion with confidential information, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
**CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.
  
  
**About CIP Terra Technologies**
CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.
  
  
We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.
  
  
We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.
  
  
**Optimized CIP Platform**
Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.
  
  
We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.

title: Manager - Tax & Regulatory
description:
**Role profile**

Reports to: Head of Finance

Experience: 5+ years in Indian taxation, compliance and litigation, including hands-on crypto tax experience

Qualification: Chartered Accountant

Location: Bangalore or Mumbai

**About the Company**

BitDelta India is a technology-led digital asset trading platform built for Indian users, focusing on security, transparency, and user experience. The platform is designed to make digital asset trading clearer, more secure, and easier to navigate for both new and experienced users. Backed by experienced fintech and technology professionals, BitDelta India combines secure infrastructure, intuitive product design, and a responsible approach to support India's growing digital asset ecosystem.

**Website: www.bitdelta.in**

**About the Role**

BitDelta is seeking a Manager – Tax & Regulatory to lead Indian tax compliance, crypto tax reporting and tax litigation. The role will own GST, TDS and income tax matters, ensuring accurate filings, defensible tax positions and timely responses to notices and assessments.

You will work closely with Finance, Product, Technology and Operations to translate Indian tax requirements into reliable transaction data, reconciliations and reporting controls. Prior hands-on experience managing Indian tax matters for a cryptocurrency or digital asset business is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Indian Direct Tax and Compliance**

* Manage corporate income tax computations, advance tax workings, income tax returns and tax audit schedules for the relevant Indian entities.
* Review current and deferred tax workings with Controllership and reconcile tax computations to the books and supporting schedules.
* Maintain an obligation-wise compliance calendar, assign preparation and review responsibilities, and ensure filings and tax payments meet applicable deadlines.
* Evaluate the Indian tax implications of business arrangements and new products, document significant positions and obtain specialist advice where required.

**GST and TDS**

* Own GST return preparation and review, outward supply reconciliations, input tax credit checks, reverse-charge workings and applicable annual compliance.
* Reconcile GST returns and portal records with sales, purchase and general ledger data; resolve mismatches, vendor documentation gaps and eligible refund matters.
* Review vendor and payroll withholding, TDS deposits, statements, certificates and corrections with AP and HR, including applicable withholding on virtual digital asset transactions.
* Maintain auditable workings for deductions, payments and return disclosures, and investigate short deductions, unmatched credits and filing exceptions.
* Review GST registrations and amendments and validate tax classification, place-of-supply and applicable invoicing requirements in coordination with Product and Finance.

**Crypto Tax Reporting and Data Controls**

* Own applicable Indian virtual digital asset and crypto-asset tax reporting, including transaction-level workings, exchange-related withholding records and prescribed statements where applicable.
* Reconcile platform transaction records, customer tax identifiers, consideration values, tax deductions, ledger balances and filed information to establish complete reporting trails.
* Work with Product and Technology to define tax data requirements, validate system calculations and test changes affecting transaction classification, tax deductions and reporting.
* Monitor changes in Indian crypto tax requirements and coordinate implementation across Finance and Operations, retaining evidence of reviews and corrections.

**Tax Litigation and Assessments**

* Manage GST and income tax notices, assessments, departmental queries and appeals; maintain a register of deadlines, exposures, submissions and next actions.
* Prepare factual workings and draft responses, organize supporting evidence and coordinate representations with authorized advisers and counsel.

**Tax Governance and Team Coordination**

* Review the Tax Executive's work and establish checklists, filing archives and backup arrangements for recurring compliance.
* Support statutory and internal audits with tax schedules and explanations, and communicate approved tax treatment to AP, HR and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on Indian tax-related information requests while maintaining clear responsibility for tax decisions and submissions.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Chartered Accountant with 4-6 years of relevant experience in Indian direct tax, GST, TDS, tax compliance and litigation.
* Mandatory hands-on experience handling Indian taxation and crypto tax reporting for a cryptocurrency or digital asset business, either in-house or through substantive client engagements.
* Practical experience with virtual digital asset transaction data, tax deductions, reconciliations and reporting requirements.
* Demonstrated experience managing notices, assessments or litigation, including drafting responses and coordinating with advisers.
* Strong Excel skills, experience with tax portals and accounting systems, and the ability to review large datasets and identify exceptions.
* Clear written communication, sound judgment and strong ownership of deadlines and confidential information.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Experience in a crypto exchange or digital asset platform with substantial transaction volumes.
* Big Four or comparable tax advisory experience alongside practical responsibility for compliance delivery.
* Experience improving tax data pipelines, reconciliation processes and filing controls with Product or Technology teams.

title: Development Engineering & Technical Director - APAC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As an experienced techno-commercial and development professional and member of an in-house team of expert techno-commercial experts, this role is responsible for highlighting, for the GE Vernova Financial Services (FS) business, the development, technical, operational, cost and schedule risks associated with equity investment in development, construction and operating power & renewable assets and projects – all for supporting investment decisions;
  
  
This individual will be responsible for identifying early to mid stage development techno-commercial risk and proposing mitigants in support of underwriting, leading due diligence and support formation and implementation of strategies within new investment platforms and portfolio reporting and management.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Specialize in assessing early to mid stage development, technical, operational, construction and development risks in the energy industry.
* Support deal execution teams through front end and customer facing involvement in development deals exhibiting deep domain knowledge and expertise in projects from inception to a “ready to build” / financial close stage.
* Support the efforts of EFS underwriting and portfolio groups in identification and mitigation of risks and in execution of investment objectives. Perform techno-commercial due diligence for both underwriting and portfolio holdings.
* Review and instructively comment on technical and construction specifications as outlined in key project documents such as interconnection, power off-take, permits, land agreements, and equipment, construction, operations and maintenance contracts, in some cases even leading / supporting the negotiations of these documents.
* Ensure that technical and business-related issues are communicated within EFS and provide techno-commercial risk assessments for credit requests
* Interact with EFS customers and partners and internal GE Power and GE Renewables teams in the completion of due diligence and negotiation of financing terms related to technical issues.
* Possess understanding of the risk appetite, and portfolio management philosophy of EFS.
* Lead due diligence processes into new investment platforms.
* Develop and structure development budgets, schedules and reporting frameworks for new investment platforms.
* Be familiar with the GE industrial product offerings and maintain contacts within GE Power and GE Renewables.
* For assigned investment platforms, manage development progress, reporting and alignment with project budgets and schedules.
* Actively monitor portfolio (e.g. regulatory requirements, development progress, construction, physical plant optimization, and contractual performance). Possess in-depth understanding of how specific sub-function interacts with the broader business, as well as a good understanding of the industry and commercial awareness.
* For assigned projects, develop and supervise construction management teams and ensure construction safety, environmental compliance, cost and schedule performance. Provide internal reporting on construction status.
* Support EFS efforts to sell equity positions through assembly of technical project information and responding to buyer’s technical questions.
* Develop and Support investment strategies into other carbon neutral GE Technologies within new markets. Specifically development into blue power and the Small Modular Reactor (SMR) space.
* Must be able to travel within India and APAC for about 40% of the time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree Civil or Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and Construction Management.
* Masters post-graduation either in engineering or management strongly preferred.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to identify, analyze and resolve technical development issues. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects.
* Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

******Additional Information******

No

title: Marine and Insurance Claims Advisor
description:
The Incident and Marine Insurance Claims Advisor combines two main responsibilities.
  
  

* The role acts as focal for Marine Insurance Claims (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances), supporting and driving the daily insurance claims processes (insurance claims operation and Insurance Claims Compliance) together with the wider Maersk claims team.
* The role manages incidents from an overall project management perspective, ensuring that all relevant insurance claims activities are coordinated, progressed and documented.

Marine Insurance Claims Focal
  
  

* Act as focal for Marine Insurance Claims (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances) processes, supporting consistent and effective claims handling across the relevant portfolio.
* Drive the daily operation of assigned Marine Insurance Claims (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances) together with the wider Maersk claims team.
* Provide practical guidance on claims handling, policy response, coverage considerations and process requirements.
* Support correct classification, registration, allocation and ongoing management of Marine Insurance Claims (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances).
* Ensure timely notification to insurers, P&I Clubs, brokers and other relevant external parties where required.
* Review claim facts, exposure, causation, policy considerations and documentation requirements.
* Support reserve setting, reserve reviews, claim updates and reporting in line with internal requirements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure that operational, legal and insurance aspects are aligned.
* Identify recovery opportunities and support recovery processes where relevant.
* Help maintain high-quality claims data, documentation and case records.

Incident Management - Major and Shipment Incidents
  
  

* Manage and coordinate assigned (within the wider Insurance and Incident Management Team) Major Incidents and Shipment Incidents from initial notification through stabilization, investigation and resolution.
* Undertake early assessment to identify potential operational, cargo, vessel, liability, insurance and legal exposures.
* Coordinate with relevant internal functions and external stakeholders to establish an appropriate incident response and claims strategy.
* Arrange and coordinate surveyors, experts, correspondents and external counsel where required.
* Support evidence preservation, investigations, surveys, documentation and fact gathering.
* Coordinate incident-related stakeholder communication and ensure timely escalation of significant developments.
* Support loss mitigation, recovery opportunities and appropriate allocation of incident-related costs.
* Participate in emergency response and provide out-of-hours support in accordance with the team's 24/7 incident response arrangements.
* Maintain appropriate case documentation, records and reporting throughout the lifecycle of the incident.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned incidents and claims matters.
* Maintain effective relationships with internal business functions, insurers, clubs, brokers, surveyors, experts, correspondents and legal counsel, as applicable.
* Provide clear, timely and practical guidance to stakeholders throughout incident and claims handling.
* Promote effective collaboration across the integrated Insurance & Incident Management function.

Process & Capability Development
  
  

* Contribute to continuous improvement of incident and claims processes, procedures and controls.
* Participate in GEMBA, knowledge-sharing and cross-training activities.
* Support development of broader incident and insurance capability across the team.
* Identify recurring issues, trends and opportunities for process improvement, loss prevention and cost reduction.

Key Accountabilities / Measures of Success
  
  

* Timely and effective response to incidents and claims.
* Clear end-to-end ownership of assigned matters.
* Appropriate and timely insurance notification and escalation.
* Quality and accuracy of claims assessment, documentation and case records.
* Effective stakeholder communication, coordination and responsiveness.
* Appropriate mitigation of exposure, costs and identification of recovery opportunities.
* Compliance with agreed processes, controls and reporting requirements.
* Contribution to team capability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Primary Stakeholders
  
  

* Fleet Management
* GRM
* MIAS
* Marine Insurers (including H&M, P&I, Equipment and other related Marine Insurances)
* Maersk Maritime law

Knowledge & Experience
  
  

* Any Graduate with 5+ yrs of Experience within marine claims, marine insurance, shipping, incident management or a related discipline.
* Good understanding of marine operations and H&M insurance principles.
* Ability to assess complex incidents and distinguish between potential H&M, P&I, contractual and other exposures.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to make sound decisions in time-sensitive and high-pressure situations.
* Comfortable working across functions and coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Head Investigations
description:
**Job Title**
Head Investigations
  
  
**Business Unit**
Global Internal Audit
  
  
**Job Grade**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you
**“Create your own sunshine”**
— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
**Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?**
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
**What will you do?**
Lead Sun Pharma's global agenda across Claims Governance, Insurance Recovery, Enterprise Risk Management, Employee Benefits Claims Administration, and Insurance Program Excellence.
  
  
Lead the global investigations and fraud risk management agenda across Sun Pharma. Ensure concerns are triaged promptly and investigated independently, objectively, lawfully and consistently. Deliver evidence-based conclusions, protect confidentiality and due process, identify root causes, and convert investigation insights into sustainable corrective actions, stronger controls and early-warning capabilities. The role serves as a trusted adviser to senior leadership while preserving the integrity and independence of the investigations process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Investigation Governance and Case Management
* Own the global investigation framework, protocols, SOPs, allegation taxonomy, escalation matrix, SLAs, and quality standards.
* Oversee intake, triage, case acceptance, scoping, and planning for whistleblower, fraud, misconduct, conflict of interest, bribery/corruption, asset misappropriation, and other sensitive matters.
* Maintain confidentiality, independence, and appropriate legal privilege requirements; engage external counsel, forensic experts, or law enforcement when required.
* Ensure complete, secure, and audit-ready case documentation and evidence records.
* Investigation Execution and Evidence
* Lead complex, high-risk, and cross-border investigations from allegation through closure.
* Develop investigation plans and oversee preservation and analysis of financial, documentary, digital, and electronic evidence.
* Conduct and supervise witness and subject interviews while ensuring fairness, cultural sensitivity, and non-retaliation.
* Leverage data analytics, e-discovery, and digital forensics to identify anomalies, relationships, and potential risks.
* Reporting, Remediation and Prevention
* Prepare clear, evidence-based investigation reports and executive summaries.
* Present significant matters and risk themes to senior management, Global Internal Audit leadership, and governance forums.
* Partner with Legal, Compliance, HR, Finance, and Information Security on remediation, disciplinary actions, and regulatory engagement.
* Drive root-cause analysis and CAPA governance, ensuring timely implementation and escalation of overdue actions.
* Translate recurring issues into fraud risk assessments, control improvements, training, and preventive measures.
* Leadership, Quality and Capability
* Lead, coach, and develop investigation teams while allocating cases based on risk, complexity, skills, and conflicts.
* Manage external forensic firms, legal counsel, and technology providers.
* Drive quality assurance and lessons-learned programs covering investigations, reporting, consistency, and stakeholder feedback.
* Foster a strong speak-up and non-retaliation culture across the organization.
* Support special reviews and assignments from the Head - Global Internal Audit.
* Decision Rights and Accountability
* Recommend case classification, scope, resourcing, escalation, and closure.
* Ensure preservation of records and access to relevant systems, information, and personnel.
* Escalate conflicts, retaliation concerns, material misconduct, control failures, and remediation gaps.
* Provide factual findings and control recommendations while employment, legal, and regulatory decisions remain with authorized functions.

**Qualification & Skills**

* CA / CMA / MBA; Additional qualifications in Insurance, Risk Management, Law, Corporate Governance, or Enterprise Risk Management preferred.
* Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) strongly preferred. CIA, CISA, CAMS, forensic accounting, digital forensics or investigation-interviewing credentials are advantageous.

**Experience**

* 12-18 years of progressive experience in corporate investigations, forensic accounting, fraud risk management, compliance, ethics, or related assurance functions, including a minimum of 4-5 years in a leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, sensitive, and cross-border investigations involving fraud, misconduct, compliance violations, whistleblower allegations, and regulatory matters.
* Experience within Big Four firms, specialist forensic practices, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
* Strong expertise across investigation planning and case management, whistleblower investigations, fraud schemes and financial analysis, interviewing, evidence preservation and chain of custody, report writing, root-cause analysis, CAPA governance, fraud risk assessments, data analytics, e-discovery, digital forensics, third-party risk management, anti-bribery and corruption, privacy requirements, employment considerations, and records-retention obligations across multiple jurisdictions.

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

title: Associate Director, Commercial
description:

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

**Our values:**

* **Responsibility:**
  We take ownership of our actions and outcomes.
* **Innovation:**
  We embrace change and create bold solutions.
* **Strive:**
  We show grit, resilience and relentless drive.
* **Excellence:**
  We pursue the highest standards in all we do.
* **Respect:**
  We act with integrity and treat others with dignity.

**What we need:**

We are seeking an Associate Director, Commercial to join our Design & Construction (D&C) team.

This senior leadership role provides commercial governance and strategic cost control across a multi-campus portfolio of hyperscale and build-to-suit data-center projects across India.

With procurement operations transitioning to the Finance organization, this role will focus on front-end commercial strategy, contract management, and risk oversight, ensuring robust commercial outcomes from early design through construction completion.

You will partner closely with Procurement, Engineering, Project Delivery, and Corporate Development to ensure cost certainty, contractual compliance, and risk mitigation across all projects in the region.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Governance**

* Collaborate with Senior Director, Commercial (Head of Platform D&C Commercial) to implement and maintain the commercial management framework, covering cost planning, contracting models (GMP, cost-plus, hybrid), and risk management.
* Lead commercial input during early feasibility and RIBA stage development, ensuring budgets, benchmarks, and cash-flow forecasts align with business objectives.
* Maintain commercial playbooks and oversee implementation within India to ensure alignment across regions, including T+X months milestone and S+X months capital deployment strategies.

**Contract Management & Risk Control**

* Drive end-to-end contract administration - from pre-contract strategy, tender review support, and commercial negotiations to final account settlement.
* Provide oversight of major EPC, D&B, and framework agreements, including change-order management, claims avoidance, and dispute resolution.
* Monitor commercial risk exposure across all projects and escalate issues with clear mitigation plans.

**Cost Planning & Reporting**

* Lead regional cost planning and benchmarking for all major construction and MEP packages.
* Maintain a standardized reporting dashboard tracking CAPEX burn, S+X months vs. T+X months spend buckets, forecast-to-complete, and variance analysis, providing leadership with clear portfolio-wide visibility.
* Support Finance on funding calls and cash-flow management by providing accurate spend projections and scenario modelling.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance-led Procurement to ensure sourcing strategies and vendor selections meet D&C technical and schedule requirements.
* Work with Engineering, Project Directors, and Operations to validate design-to-budget alignment and incorporate lessons learned into future contracts.
* Interface with JV partners, lenders, and hyperscale customers on commercial matters and reporting.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build and mentor a regional commercial management team skilled in cost planning, contract administration, and project controls.
* Champion the use of commercial management tools and data analytics to drive visibility and continuous improvement.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of commercial management experience in large-scale data-center, mission-critical infrastructure, or major construction projects, including 5+ years in a regional leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of contract law, cost control methodologies, and risk management frameworks.
* Proven ability to manage high-value contracts across multiple Asian markets and to collaborate effectively with Finance-led procurement teams.
* Familiarity with international contract standards (e.g., FIDIC) and regional construction norms.
* Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
* RICS, MRICS, or equivalent commercial management certification preferred..

title: Senior Associate, Country Legal - India
description:
*Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions is looking for a Senior Associate, Legal to join our office in Mumbai*
**Team**
You will join the India legal team, led by the Legal Counsel and made up of 3–4 lawyers. The team provides integrated legal support across CIP’s Indian renewable energy portfolio, covering project contracts, financing, JV and shareholder matters, real estate and regulatory work, and corporate governance. It works closely with the investment, debt finance, commercial and finance teams, and with external counsel, and collaborates with CIP colleagues in Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
**Role**
Reporting to the Legal Counsel, you will provide legal support to CIP and the CIP-managed funds’ renewable energy portfolio in India, with a high level of self-management. You will oversee transactions and workstreams end to end, act as a trusted adviser to the India business teams, and be a key point of contact for our global legal, investment and finance colleagues across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific. You will also guide and review the work of junior team members and external counsel .The workload varies, so flexibility is expected from both sides, particularly for calls with colleagues in Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific. We will support your learning and development, and you will have room to help shape the function, its processes and its templates as the team grows .T his is a full-time, office-based position at our Mumbai office in BKC, working closely with the India team and collaborating with colleagues across time zones.
  
  
**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:**

* Manage the drafting, negotiation and management of EPC, O&M, supply, and other construction and operations contracts for wind, solar and storage projects, including escalated issues and claims.
* Lead legal workstreams on project financing and project development, including reviewing and negotiating financing, security creation and perfection documents, and coordinating legal opinions and conditions precedent with lenders’ and external counsel.
* Negotiate and manage general commercial contracts, including power purchase agreements, lease and land agreements, and other project agreements, and advise on risk allocation.
* Support JV management, including advising on shareholders’ and JV agreements, governance, transfer and exit mechanics, and day-to-day JV matters.
* Support M&A and acquisition-related activity for projects and portfolio companies, including legal due diligence, transaction documents and closing processes, in coordination with the investment team and external counsel.
* Advise the projects team on regulatory approvals, permits and real estate matters, including title diligence and land acquisition, and manage disputes and regulatory issues with local counsel.
* Manage litigation and disputes (where they arise), including briefing, supervising and reporting on matters handled by external counsel.
* Advise on India-specific company secretarial, Board and Executive Committee matters, insurance, and ethical and governance issues, and ensure compliance with internal CIP/CIP FS policies and procedures.
* Support operational legal matters for CIP FS India, such as NDAs and engagement letters, and advise on HR and admin issues.
* Monitor regulatory and legislative developments in the Indian renewables sector, assess their impact and advise the business.
* Manage, brief and review the work of external counsel, including cost-effectiveness, and guide and mentor junior team members.

**You:**
You have graduated from a reputed law school in India and are qualified to practise law in India, with 4–6 years of post-qualification experience, including at least 2 years at a reputable law firm. You have experience in energy, infrastructure, project finance, M&A and real estate, with direct exposure to renewable energy projects such as wind, solar or energy storage considered a significant advantage. You also have demonstrated experience leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex commercial contracts and managing transactions with little supervision.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Close attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Sound commercial judgement and the ability to give clear, practical advice to non-lawyers.
* Good organization and prioritization across multiple matters, with the ability to work with minimal supervision and take initiative.
* Ability to guide and mentor junior colleagues and to manage external counsel effectively.
* Interest in renewable energy assets and in regulatory changes and updates.
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written, with effective communication skills.
* Willingness to work in an international, fast-paced and varied environment across time zones.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
---
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions**
CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.
  
  
For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
