title: Manager ,Restructuring
description:
**Associate Vice President, Restructuring**
Our Restructuring practices’ aim is to provide effective solutions to its clients. Our clients include major high street banks, asset-based lenders, private equity houses, accountants, solicitors, financial sponsors, lenders, creditors, corporates and individuals. We are tasked with offering transaction and advisory services along with expert guidance to both domestic and foreign organizations in distressed situations across virtually every industry and every situation.
  
  
We are seeking an Associate Vice President to work with clients to advise them on how they can simplify their group structures. This role will be based in India and will collaborate closely with global teams in UK and Europe region.
  
  
You will be involved throughout all stages of the simplification lifecycle, working as part of a team to advise clients on how to dispose of and reorganise corporate entities, realise assets, resolve outstanding issues such as the settlement of creditor claims and assist in the distribution of the surplus assets to shareholders.
  
  
You will broaden your knowledge as part of a fast-growing global team that has strong relationships and networks across different industry groups and jurisdictions.
  
  
You will develop an impressive range of advisory and technical implementation skills, gaining exposure to company legislation and accounting principles. This will foster a solid legal and financial understanding of different clients and businesses that will offer you both growth and career progression opportunities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify opportunities for process improvement by conducting root cause testing of all compliance and business metrics
* Determine areas of strength or Business Execution opportunity within defined scope of work
* Review and research strategies and action plans to establish effective processes while meeting performance metrics and policy expectations
* Utilize independent judgment to guide moderate risk deliverables
* Present recommendations to develop, implement, and monitor strategic approaches, effectiveness of support function, and business performance improvement opportunities for managing risks of the business
* Exercise independent judgment and provide guidance in diverse support functions and operations for a single business group within a line of business
* Collaborate and consult with leaders and executive management
* Provide work direction to less experienced Strategy and Execution staff

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Possess strong knowledge of banking products and services across key lines of business, including Consumer Lending, Commercial Banking, Wealth & Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Capital Markets.
* Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.

**Job Expectations**

* Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
* Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
* Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
* Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
* Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
* Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
* Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
* Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
* Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
* Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
* Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
* Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
* Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

* Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
* Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
* Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
* Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
* Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.

description:
**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE**

Ramco Systems is part of the
**$1 billion+ diversified Ramco Group**
, a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.

**Ramco Systems**
is the Group’s technology arm, delivering
**next-gen enterprise software**
across
**Global Payroll**
,
**HR**
,
**Aviation MRO**
,
**ERP**
, and
**Logistics**
. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35+ countries and is recognized for its
**AI/ML-based**
,
**bot-enabled**
, and
**cloud-native**
solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The
**Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau**
oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.

The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.

The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Regional Compliance Ownership & Governance**

* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end-to-end statutory updates —
  **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release**
  — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit-ready documentation standards.

**Regulatory Interpretation & Technical Oversight**

* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.

**Leadership, Team Management & Capability Building**

* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Confidence**

* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end-to-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.

**Strategic Initiatives & Innovation**

* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future-readiness.

**Training & Knowledge Enablement**

* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness**
  — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
  *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy**
  — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
  *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation**
  — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality**
  — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign-off.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance**
  — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence**
  — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement**
  — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Qualified
  **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer**
  with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10+ years in multi-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI-assisted regulatory research tooling.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

The position is based in Chennai, India, reporting to the Senior Manager, Procurement Competence Centre. International travel of up to 15 days per year may be required based on business needs.
  
  
**Collaborative procurement professional with global mindset**
You enjoy working with people across different functions, cultures, and locations. You are organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail. You will contribute to infrastructure projects that support the expansion of renewable energy networks and gain exposure to global suppliers, complex contract management, and cross-functional collaboration in a growing business environment.
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

**15th September 2026**

title: Paralegal
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**

* The team member is responsible for ensuring accounts impacted by bankruptcy are handled in strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This role involves reviewing and processing bankruptcy notifications, and updates, received from approved vendors or mail, coding accounts as bankrupt in the appropriate system of record, and excluding them from collection activities to prevent violations of the automatic stay.
* The Associate researches and resolves match criteria exclusions, manages manual coding for exceptions, and monitors joint filings and community property cases. Additional duties include quality assurance reviews, maintaining accurate documentation, collaborating with attorneys and account holders, and supporting compliance through regular training and adherence to procedural controls.
* The position covers a range of consumer and small business products, including credit cards, lines of credit, and installment loans. Strong attention to detail, excellent Microsoft suite skills, ability to complete complex tasks with minimal oversight and critical thinking skills.
* Experienced paralegal responsible for legal research, preparation of legal documents, file management and other assigned or routine tasks. Works under direct supervision using established principles, practices and procedures. Ability to determine and use appropriate internal and external resources.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Proofs of Claim are legal documents submitted to bankruptcy courts to assert the bank’s claim for amounts owed. Filing must meet strict court deadlines (“Bar Dates”).
* Not all accounts require a POC. Automated and manual reviews ensure only eligible, compliant claims are filed (e.g., not out-of-statute, not low-value, not fees/interest only).
* Every POC undergoes multi-level review—first by the preparer, then by an approved designee, with checklists and system controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Claims are filed electronically (ECF/PACER) or manually, depending on court requirements. Special handling is required for certain jurisdictions and product types.
* Claims can be amended or withdrawn for valid reasons (e.g., errors, payments, jurisdictional issues), but require management/designee approval.

**Competencies:**

* Bankruptcy Regulatory Compliance
* Account Review and Judgment
* Attention to Detail and Accuracy
* Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving
* Risk Identification and Mitigation
* Quality Assurance and Control Execution
* Independent Execution and Accountability
* Documentation and Recordkeeping
* Collaboration and Professional Communication
* Adaptability and Continuous Learning

**Skills:**

* Bankruptcy account coding and collection exclusion, Bankruptcy notification review and processing.
* Automatic stay compliance.
* Match criteria research and exclusion resolution.
* Manual coding and exception processing.
* Joint filing and community property case management.
* Quality assurance review and control validation.
* Account documentation and audit-ready recordkeeping.
* Microsoft 365 proficiency.
* Complex task management and stakeholder communication

**Qualifications:**
Basic Qualifications - Paralegal certification from an accredited program, or equivalent degree or experience Preferred Skills/Experience - Three to five years of relevant experience - Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills - Strong commitment to client service - Ability to work independently - Ability to organize and manage a large volume of detailed tasks.
  
  
**Years of Experience**
: 3+ Relevant years

: 6:30pm-3:30am IST

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Senior Privacy Analyst – DSAR & Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Privacy Operations Analyst drives the day-to-day execution of the company’s global privacy compliance program, spanning UK/EU, US, APAC, and other regions in which the business operates. This role goes beyond individual task execution to own program-level activities: coordinating data subject rights requests, running and reporting on privacy risk assessments, maintaining data mapping and records of processing activities (ROPA), and using work-management and privacy automation tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps/Jira, OneTrust, Power Automate) to scale the privacy program’s operational cadence and reporting. The role partners closely with the Privacy Operations Lead, Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Privacy Program Management & Reporting
  
  

* Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.
* Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.
* Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.
* Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.

Privacy Risk Assessments
  
  

* Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.
* Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.
* Support efforts to reduce manual effort in assessment scoring and risk rating, applying sound judgment on what can be automated versus what must remain human-reviewed.

Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance
  
  

* Maintain and update the company’s records of processing activities (ROPA), tying outputs directly to data mapping and risk assessment findings.
* Support data discovery and data flow mapping efforts across the organization’s systems, environments, and third-party integrations, leveraging data discovery tooling where available.
* Support an ongoing ownership and maintenance model for the data map/ROPA, including monitoring for drift as systems or vendors change and reconciling against discovery tool outputs.

Privacy Compliance & Risk Management
  
  

* Monitor and track changes in privacy regulations across jurisdictions, and support compliance with key regulations including UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable regimes.
* Support privacy incident response and breach notification processes, including incident documentation and breach register maintenance.
* Support privacy audits and assessments of internal processes and third-party vendors.

Privacy-by-Design & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Support the intake and triage of privacy-related inquiries from internal stakeholders and customers.
* Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, Product, and Business teams to support the integration of privacy-by-design principles into the product development cycle.
* Assist with privacy training content delivery and tracking across the business.
* Support vendor and partner reviews to ensure contractual privacy obligations are met, and help identify current sub-processors for contractual documentation updates.

Documentation & Governance
  
  

* Contribute to internal privacy policy, procedure, and operational playbook documentation.
* Maintain privacy metrics, dashboards, and reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and quality review to junior privacy operations team members on documentation and process adherence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-7 years of experience in a privacy, compliance, legal operations, or similar role, supporting a global or multi-jurisdictional privacy program.
* Working knowledge of UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable global data subject rights frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with privacy management platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) configuring or running DSAR, PIA/DPIA, and data mapping workflows.
* Experience using work-management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira) to structure and track privacy operations work, including building reporting dashboards and KPIs for leadership.
* Exposure to or experience with automation of privacy workflows (e.g., Power Automate, API integrations between privacy platforms and ticketing systems) to reduce manual effort in DSAR, assessment, and data mapping processes.
* Understanding of data discovery and data mapping tooling and techniques to keep ROPA records current and minimize drift.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief stakeholders on program status and risk.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM certification, or actively pursuing.
* Experience building ADO/Jira custom work item types, boards, and Power BI or analytics dashboards for privacy KPI reporting.
* Experience with data discovery/classification tools (e.g., OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra).
* Prior experience in a shared services, global operations, or multinational organization.
* Familiarity with basic scripting or low-code automation (e.g., Power Automate) to support privacy workflow automation.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams and time zones
* Adaptability to changing regulatory landscapes
* Cultural sensitivity for working in a global environment
* Technical aptitude for understanding data flows, systems, and automation tooling

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. title: Manager - Legal Counsel
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Provide sound and independent legal counsel and advice across corporate, commercial, contract, compliance, litigation and regulatory matters. Partner with business leaders and functions to identify legal risks, develop pragmatic solutions, and support the organization in achieving its business objectives while maintaining very high level of legal and compliance standards. Support the business as a strategic legal partner across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR, Finance and other functions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Legal Advisory & Business Partnering:**

* Provide day-to-day legal advice to business functions on operational, commercial, and strategic matters.
* Understand business requirements and provide practical legal solutions while identifying and mitigating legal and commercial risks.
* Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR and other functions on legal matters.
* Conduct and coordinate legal research on a variety of legal issues.

**Contracts & Commercial Matters**

* Draft, review, negotiate and finalize a variety of commercial contracts, NDAs, SLAs, and SOWs.
* Conduct due diligence reviews considering applicable global and local requirements, business complexity and organizational policies, with a focus on mitigating legal and commercial risk.
* Review commercial terms relating to purchase orders, invoices, letters of credit, bank guarantees, etc.

**Corporate, Compliance & Regulatory**

* Advise on applicable corporate, commercial, labour and other regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen legal compliance processes and support internal audits of legal documentation and processes.
* Provide compliance awareness trainings.
* Liaise with various regulatory authorities and respond to legal notices, regulatory queries, etc.

**Litigation & Dispute Management**

* Manage and coordinate civil, criminal, consumer, arbitration, product liability, service liability, IPR and labour-related disputes.
* Develop litigation strategy, coordinate with external counsel and support matters through investigation, documentation, negotiation and resolution.
* Draft/review legal notices, petitions and documents in consultation with management & external counsel.
* Ensure timely follow-up, effective case management and speedy resolution of disputes.
* Support litigation avoidance and legal risk minimization through stronger contracts, processes and preventive legal controls.

**Intellectual Property & Technology**

* Provide legal support on intellectual property, trademarks, technology-related matters, software licensing, IT services and digitalization initiatives.
* Review technology and digital business arrangements and advise on related legal and commercial risks.
* Provide legal guidance on new products, technologies, AI initiatives and digital transformation projects, coordinating with specialist teams where required.

**E-Legal / Legal Digitalization**

* Support implementation and effective use of legal digitalization tools.
* Review relevant checklists and coordinate with stakeholders for effective implementation.
* Identify opportunities to improve legal processes and systems, enabling effective compliance, efficient ways of working, and better coordination with internal teams.

**Data Privacy, AI & Cybersecurity**

* Design and implement Data Privacy and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework, with an understanding of GDPR and other applicable privacy frameworks.
* Draft, review and negotiate privacy-related clauses, agreements, notices and policies.
* Support data mapping, data retention, consent management, and cross-border data transfer reviews.
* Provide legal guidance on AI/Generative AI governance and associated legal or compliance risks, as well as new products, technologies and digital transformation initiatives.
* Understand cybersecurity / information security legal risks sufficiently to identify key legal implications, ask the right questions, and coordinate with specialist teams.
* Coordinate with IT, Cybersecurity, HR, Procurement and business teams on privacy and technology-related compliance initiatives.

Knowledge of handling assets and employee-related insurance matters, including insurance renewal requirements and claims support, will be an advantage.
  
  
**Who are you?**
You are a LLB or LLM from a leading University with 10–15 years of relevant legal experience, preferably with strong in-house legal exposure in a multinational, automotive, manufacturing and technology organization, including exposure to R&D environments. You can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and advise senior stakeholders with sound legal judgement under high-stress, time-critical conditions. You have strong capabilities in contracts, commercial law, corporate law, IPR, compliance, litigation, and legal risk management. Exposure to Data Privacy/DPDP, AI, and Cybersecurity related legal topics are an additional advantage. Excellent analytical, legal research and problem-solving skills with the capability to challenge status quo. You can take a firm stand, are a team player, maintain a positive and collaborative approach, and handle conflicts constructively. You have experience in a global organization and exposure to international stakeholders. You have very good written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex legal matters clearly and simply to business stakeholders. If you can read and write Kannada, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Group Legal & Compliance**
contributes to realizing the vision of the Volvo Group by coordinating and providing services within the following areas: Legal, Governance, Security and Internal Audit. With Volvo Group Legal & Compliance you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Risk & Regulation - MSP - Senior Manager, you will focus on maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. Within our Risk & Regulatory practice, you will guide clients through complex regulatory landscapes, enhancing their internal controls to mitigate risks effectively. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach teams to solve complex problems, applying sound judgment to recognize when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain diverse and inclusive teams contributes to the success of our firm.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback. You will direct teams through complexity, demonstrating composure in challenging situations. By crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages, you will tell a holistic story that aligns with client needs. Your commitment to excellence and ability to initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels will drive the overall success of our projects and enhance client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading regulatory compliance initiatives to help clients navigate complex regulatory landscapes
* Developing and implementing compliance strategies to mitigate risks effectively
* Managing client relationships and providing strategic advice on regulatory risk compliance
* Overseeing the design and execution of compliance audits and assessments
* Coordinating with cross-functional teams to enhance internal controls and governance frameworks
* Conducting risk analysis and monitoring to identify potential compliance issues
* Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that communicate compliance requirements
* Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities in compliance processes
* Directing teams through complex regulatory challenges with composure and strategic questioning
* Validating outcomes with clients and acting on feedback to improve compliance solutions

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 6 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Demonstrating advanced skills in Anti-Money Laundering Compliance
* Utilizing comprehensive knowledge of Governance Risk Compliance (GRC)
* Applying strategic questioning to drive regulatory compliance initiatives
* Excelling in compliance program implementation and maintenance
* Leading teams through complex regulatory challenges with composure
* Innovating processes to enhance compliance auditing and reporting
* Building and sustaining diverse, inclusive, and high-performing teams

title: CLM Consultant
description:
Spaulding Ridge is an advisory and IT implementation firm. We help global organizations get financial clarity into the complex, daily sales, and operational decisions that impact profitable revenue generations, efficient operational performance, and reliable financial management.
  
  
At Spaulding Ridge, we believe all business is personal. Core to our values is our relationships with our clients, our business partners, our team, and the global community. Our employees dedicate their time to helping our clients transform their business, from strategy through implementation and business transformation.
  
  
**What You Will Do And Learn**
We are looking for an experienced Legal Operations Consultant/CLM Specialist to join our Legal Operations practice. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Ironclad and/or Agiloft Contract Lifecycle Management platforms, with the ability to contribute across implementation, pre-sales, solution architecture, integrations, and client success activities.
  
  
**Ideal candidates will be able to:**
**Technical Expertise**

* Design, develop, and implement custom solutions using the Ironclad and/or Agiloft platform.
* Create and maintain integrations between Ironclad and/or Agiloft and other enterprise systems.
* Develop and optimize workflows, templates, business rules, dashboards, and automation processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Ironclad and/or Agiloft implementations.
* Build and customize contract templates on Agiloft and configure workflows, rules, and dashboards.
* Work with APIs and connectors to support smooth data flow across connected systems.
* Hands-on expertise with Agiloft KB configuration, business rules, workflow automation, custom calculations, and data integration capabilities.

**Pre-Sales Support**

* Participate in client meetings and presentations to demonstrate Ironclad and/or Agiloft/CLM capabilities.
* Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concept activities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to create tailored solutions for potential clients.
* Assist in preparing technical proposals and responding to RFPs.

**Solution Architecture**

* Design and architect end-to-end solutions leveraging Ironclad and/or Agiloft/CLM platforms.
* Create detailed solution designs and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance and best practices to clients and internal teams.
* Evaluate client requirements and propose appropriate Ironclad and/or Agiloft/CLM solutions.

**Client Success & Collaboration**

* Advise clients on Ironclad and/or Agiloft/CLM best practices and industry standards.
* Provide technical expertise during implementation projects.
* Conduct training sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Collaborate with international teams and business stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance and best practices across projects.
* Mentor and coach team members and help expand team expertise on Agiloft.
* Stay up to date with the latest Ironclad and/or Agiloft/CLM features and industry trends.

**Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of experience working with Ironclad and/or Agiloft and CLM platforms.
* Understanding of legal fundamentals, methods and procedures, with the ability to review contracts.
* Strong understanding of contract management processes and workflows.
* Proficiency in Ironclad and/or Agiloft API, eSignature, and CLM administration.
* Experience with Ironclad and/or Agiloft CLM (Springs) configuration and customization.
* Experience integrating Agiloft with systems such as CRM, ERP, and e-signature tools.
* Familiarity with integration technologies including REST APIs, SOAP, XML, and JSON.
* Experience in solution design and architecture for enterprise-level projects.
* Ability to understand and interpret technical requirements from non-technical clients and team members, and explain technical topics clearly.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.

**Certification & Preferred Experience**

* Ironclad and/or Agiloft certifications such as Certified Administrator are required.
* Experience with other CLM platforms such as Docusign, SpotDraft, Icertis, Conga, or Apttus is preferred.
* Knowledge of CRM systems such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics is preferred.
* Understanding of legal and compliance requirements in contract management is preferred.
* Experience working in agile development methodologies is preferred.

**We take care of you!**
As an employee of Spaulding Ridge, you will part of a company that is providing innovative opportunities to impact our clients in a meaningful way. We believe giving back is core to our values and as part of this effort, you will be given the opportunity to participate in different opportunities throughout the year including SR’s day of service, giving back to our global community. Here are some our great perks and top benefits to highlight:
  
  

* Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and accidental cover
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid holiday time
* Paid maternity and paternity leave
* Monthly technology, wellness, internet, and meal allowance
* Annual training allowance program

**Spaulding Ridge’s Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace**
When we engage the expertise, insights, and creativity of people from all walks of life, we become a better organization, we deliver superior services to clients, and we transform our communities and world for the better.
  
  
At Spaulding Ridge, we believe our team should reflect the rich diversity of society and we take seriously the responsibility to cultivate a workplace where every bandmate feels accepted, respected, and valued for who they are. We do this by creating a culture of trust and belonging, through practices and policies that support inclusion, and through our employee led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs): CRE (Cultural Race and Ethnicity), Women Elevate, PROUD and Mental Wellness Alliance.
  
  
The company is committed to offering Equal Employment Opportunity and to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Spaulding Ridge and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to our VP of Human Resources, Cara Halladay (challaday@spauldingridge.com). Requests for reasonable accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

title: Human Capital Management - Employee Relations - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**OUR IMPACT**
As a division, Human Capital Management (HCM) is at the forefront of supporting business growth and change at Goldman Sachs by recruiting, developing, and rewarding the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design, and implement strategies, processes, and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity, and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.
  
  
**THE EMPLOYEE RELATIONS (ER) TEAM**
The Employee Relations team, which is part of the Human Capital Management division, is dedicated to advising and coaching managers and employees on all aspects of the employment relationship. Working with managers and employees to prevent, advise and resolve challenging and complex workplace situations, the ER Advisor will work to protect and support the firm's culture in accordance with firm policies, our business principles, and applicable legal standards. The work is invariably of a sensitive nature and requires a unique combination of skills to deliver workable solutions on a diverse range of issues.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Are you looking for a new opportunity to showcase your employment relationship, performance management, disciplinary actions, and business restructurings skills? Do you have excellent communication, problem solving and leadership skills? We have an excellent position in the Human Capital Management (HCM) division’s Employee Relations function, located in the firms’ Bengaluru or Hyderabad Office.
  
  
You will be valued for your intellectual curiosity and your innovative approach to problem-solving. You will have direct impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset: Our people.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Handle HR investigations to confirm issues are solved in adherence to policies.
* Senior contact for disciplinary actions, escalations & issue remediation.
* Provide advice to managers regarding all aspects of the employment relationship, including performance management, disciplinary actions, terminations, and business restructurings.
* Investigate allegations of unfair or unlawful treatment and/or inappropriate behavior.
* Counsel individual employees regarding problems in the office and advising on health and personal issues that may impact work.
* Oversee adherence to firm policies regarding, among others, use of firm resources including e-mail and Internet access, protection of confidential information, etc.
* Oversee all terminations and implementation of severance policy.
* Assist in formulating, interpreting, and communicating policies that pertain to employee relations issues.
* Conduct training programs to educate employees about firm policies regarding employee relations issues.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel as necessary to resolve employee issues.
* Stabilize, motivate, bind teams create and uphold strong Goldman Sachs culture.

**Skills & Experience We’re Looking For**
Highly motivated HR professional or Employment Lawyer, with a solid understanding of employment issues and a proven track record of the following:
  
  

* 9+ years of relevant work experience in HR and Employee Relations
* Managing complex issues, identifying potential risk, and driving resolution
* Leveraging analytical, teamwork and project management skills to undertake thorough investigations.
* Ability to develop and build relationships at all levels, with a proven track record of acting in an advisory capacity.
* Developing and building effective relationships at all levels to advise and influence effectively.
* Bringing groups with diverse views/priorities to a common resolution through use of strong negotiation and facilitation skills
* Approaching issues strategically; anticipating consequences and navigating around unforeseen obstacles
* Listening actively and thinking creatively to deliver commercially pragmatic solutions and resolve conflicts.
* Ability to demonstrate approachability and empathy so that employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Well-developed organizational and multi-tasking skills, with strong attention to detail

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
  
  
© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2023. All rights reserved.
  
  
Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer Female/Minority/Disability/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

title: Sr. Manager - Paralegal
description:
**About**
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.
  
  
Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Senior Manager, Paralegal, you lead the GBS Paralegal function within Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") GBS India Legal Center of Excellence, reporting to the Director of Legal. You own paralegal service delivery, setting standards that hold up across genuinely different subject matters while keeping day-to-day delivery consistent and dependable for Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance, and business stakeholders worldwide. This role calls for an experienced legal operations leader with strong people leadership, sharp organizational instincts and real depth across legal documentation, contract administration, entity governance and regulatory support.
  
  
FME is looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who can build a high-performing team from the ground up, push continuous improvement, and keep service quality high in a complex, multinational, tightly regulated environment.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
***Paralegal Leadership***

* Lead and manage the GBS Paralegal function, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across OHS, corporate/M&A, and litigation workstreams
* Set standards, policies, procedures and service-delivery models for paralegal activities that work across genuinely different subject matters without forcing artificial uniformity
* Build team capability, set operating priorities, and keep the function aligned with Global Legal Function objectives
* Drive resource planning, workload balancing and operational efficiency across the paralegal team
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and service excellence

***Corporate Governance & Entity Management Oversight***

* Oversee entity management activities delivered by the M&A/Corporate Paralegal workstream, including incorporation, dissolution, restructuring, maintenance, and governance compliance support
* Oversee board and committee support activities - resolutions, minutes, governance documentation, statutory filings, ensuring accuracy and consistency
* Ensure corporate records are maintained accurately and in line with legal and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, company secretaries and local legal teams to support governance obligations across jurisdictions
* Monitor governance calendars and filing requirements across the entity portfolio

***Legal Documentation Oversight***

* Provide leadership and oversight for preparation, review, administration and maintenance of legal documentation across the paralegal team
* Ensure legal documentation processes are standardized, compliant and efficient
* Maintain document quality standards and governance controls

***Compliance, Regulatory & Risk Support***

* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk and Regulatory Affairs teams to support key compliance initiatives, including OHS regulatory matters
* Coordinate legal documentation and responses related to audits, investigations, regulatory inquiries and litigation support activities
* Support implementation of governance and compliance programmes across regions
* Identify operational risks across the paralegal function and put appropriate mitigation measures in place

***Process Excellence & Operational Improvement***

* Drive continuous improvement to lift service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction
* Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates and playbooks across paralegal workstreams
* Monitor key performance indicators and service-delivery metrics for the function

***Knowledge Management & Legal Operations Support***

* Oversee legal knowledge repositories, templates and document management systems used by the paralegal team
* Ensure legal information is maintained, organized, accessible and properly governed
* Contribute to broader legal transformation initiatives and best-practice implementation led by the Director
* Promote knowledge sharing and operational consistency across the paralegal function

***Stakeholder Management***

* Build strong relationships with Legal leadership, Compliance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Internal Audit and business stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor on paralegal processes, governance matters and legal operational support requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, regulators, government authorities and third-party service providers where required

***People Leadership & Talent Development***

* Lead, coach and develop the team members
* Drive talent management, succession planning and employee engagement across the team
* Foster collaboration across the team's different workstreams and subject-matter areas
* Create an inclusive, supportive, high-performance team environment

**Our Requirements**
***Education***

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, Corporate Governance, or a related field
* Paralegal Certification, Legal Operations Certification, or equivalent professional qualification preferred
* Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are an advantage

***Professional Experience***

* 10+ years of experience in Paralegal, Corporate Governance, Legal Operations, or related legal support functions
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing teams
* Extensive experience supporting multinational organizations in a complex regulatory environment
* Demonstrated experience in corporate governance, entity management, contract administration and legal documentation
* Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or other highly regulated industries preferred
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and operational excellence initiatives
* Experience partnering with senior legal and business stakeholders across geographies

**Functional & Technical Competencies**
***Legal & Governance Expertise***

* Corporate Governance
* Board and Committee Administration
* Entity Management
* Legal Documentation Management
* Contract Lifecycle Support
* Regulatory Compliance Support
* Corporate Records Management
* Due Diligence Support
* Litigation and Investigation Support
* Legal Risk Awareness

***Legal Operations & Process Excellence***

* Legal Operations
* Process Standardization
* Continuous Improvement
* Service Delivery Management
* Policy and Procedure Development
* Operational Governance
* Quality Assurance
* Documentation Controls
* Vendor Coordination

***Technology & Systems***

* Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Tools
* Entity Management Systems
* Document Management Systems
* Legal Operations Platforms
* Microsoft 365 Applications
* Reporting and Analytics Tools
* Knowledge Management Platforms

**Leadership Competencies**
***People Leadership***
Motivates, develops and inspires the team while building a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  
  
***Strategic Execution***
Translates legal and business priorities into practical operational plans and delivers measurable results.
  
  
***Stakeholder Influence***
Builds credibility and trusted relationships with legal leadership, business partners and external stakeholders.
  
  
***Operational Leadership***
Drives efficiency, consistency, quality and governance across the paralegal function.
  
  
***Talent Development***
Builds organizational capability through coaching, mentoring, succession planning and capability building.
  
  
***Decision Making***
Uses sound judgment, legal awareness and business understanding to make balanced, timely decisions.
  
  
**Behavioural Competencies**
***Collaboration***
Works effectively across functions and organizational levels to reach shared objectives.
  
  
***Customer Focus***
Understands stakeholder needs and consistently delivers strong service.
  
  
***Communication***
Communicates clearly, professionally and confidently with diverse audiences, including senior stakeholders.
  
  
***Integrity & Ethics***
Operates with professionalism, discretion, confidentiality and sound ethical judgment.
  
  
***Accountability***
Owns commitments, delivers results, and follows through.
  
  
***Adaptability***
Stays effective through a changing regulatory and business environment, managing competing priorities well.
  
  
***Continuous Improvement***
Questions existing practices and actively looks for ways to improve processes and outcomes.
  
  
***Attention to Detail***
Maintains a high level of accuracy and quality, particularly in governance and legal documentation work.
  
  
***Problem Solving***
Analyzes issues proactively, identifies practical solutions and drives resolution.
  
  
**Success Measures**
The Senior Manager, Paralegal will be evaluated on:
  
  
  

* Quality and consistency of paralegal service delivery across all workstreams
* Corporate governance compliance and entity management effectiveness
* Stakeholder satisfaction and partnership effectiveness
* Process efficiency and operational improvement achievements
* Accuracy and timeliness of legal documentation and governance activities
* Team engagement, capability development and retention
* Adoption of standardized processes and best practices
* Contribution to legal operational excellence within the CoE

**Additional Skill Requirements**

* Working understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and the legal implications of generative AI technologies
* Experience supporting legal digital transformation and legal service modernization initiatives
* Ability to read legal operations data and translate it into operational improvements and recommendations
* Experience working with distributed teams across regions in virtual and matrix environments
* Understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, data privacy and corporate governance
* Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of new technologies and change initiatives across a legal organization

**Preferred Professional Certifications**
***Legal & Paralegal Certifications***

* Certified Paralegal (CP)
* Advanced Certified Paralegal (ACP)
* Professional Paralegal (PP)
* Certified Legal Manager (CLM)
* Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP)

***Corporate Governance Certifications***

* Chartered Governance Professional (CGP)
* Corporate governance certifications through ICSA/CGI, the Society for Corporate Governance, or Diligent Governance Programs

***Legal Technology & AI Certifications (any)***

* CLOC Legal Operations Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Microsoft Power BI Certification
* Generative AI for Legal Professionals, Thomson Reuters AI Skills Programs, LexisNexis AI Certification Programs, or ACC Artificial Intelligence for Legal Professionals Programs
* Practical experience with tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Icertis/Ironclad CLM, Diligent Entities, and Legal Tracker/Brightflag is a plus

**Our offer:**

* Growth Opportunity: Be part of the dynamic growth and transformation of Fresenius Medical Care India Global Hub.
* Career Development: Access to challenging and rewarding opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Hybrid Work Environment: Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup that supports productivity and work-life balance.
* Transportation Facilities: Convenient company-provided cab services for pick-up and drop-off.
* Comprehensive Medical Benefits: Attractive medical benefits coverage for employees and their families.
* Cafeteria Benefits: Complimentary lunch facility at the workplace.
* Global Exposure: Gain valuable global exposure and access to diverse learning and development opportunities

title: Specialist – IP (Patents)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Specialist – IP (Patents) plays a critical role in supporting Haleon by providing high-quality intellectual property intelligence, analysis and strategic insight across the full innovation lifecycle for our R&D organisation and Cross Category IP issues and initiatives.
  
  
Working within the Legal function and under the direction of our Patent Attorneys, the role partners very closely with R&D stakeholders, including the Senior Directors, Platform Leads and Project Leads, to inform innovation, technology and partnering decisions. The role combines deep expertise in patent searching, information science and intelligence analysis with the ability to synthesise complex patent, scientific and commercial information into clear, actionable business and IP recommendations.
  
  
The Specialist – IP (Patents) supports the identification of innovation opportunities, assessment of external technologies and partners, development of IP strategies and roadmaps, and execution of patent protection and freedom-to-operate activities. The role is instrumental in helping Haleon make informed decisions about where to innovate, how to protect valuable innovations and how to manage intellectual property risks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Innovation Intelligence, White Space & Technology Insights**

* Proactively engage with scientists, innovation teams and project stakeholders to identify emerging technologies, concepts, invention opportunities and potential external partnerships at the earliest stages of development, ensuring IP opportunities, risks and strategic considerations are identified even before formal project briefs, invention disclosures or prototype designs are available.
* Develop and deliver patent landscapes, white space analyses and technology assessments to support innovation strategy and investment decisions.
* Identify emerging technologies, scientific developments, competitor activities and patent filing trends relevant to Haleon's strategic priorities.
* Conduct analyses to support "where-to-play" decisions for R&D programmes.
* Integrate patent, scientific, technical and commercial information to identify opportunities, risks and areas for strategic focus.
* Monitor evolving technology areas and provide regular intelligence updates to stakeholders.
* Translate complex datasets into concise, actionable recommendations for technical and business audiences.

**External Innovation & Partner Assessment**

* Support the evaluation of external innovation opportunities, including universities, start-ups, technology companies and other potential collaboration partners.
* Conduct IP due diligence and assess the strength, quality and strategic relevance of third-party patent portfolios.
* Identify opportunities, risks, ownership considerations and potential freedom-to-operate issues associated with prospective partnerships and licensing opportunities.
* Provide IP intelligence and analysis to support partnership, licensing and collaboration recommendations.

**IP Strategy Support**

* Provide analytical support to the Patent Attorney in the development of IP strategies and portfolio roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities for patent protection and portfolio development arising from R&D activities.
* Contribute to the assessment of potential IP risks and support the development of risk mitigation strategies.
* Support strategic decision-making through the delivery of evidence-based insights and recommendations.
* Help ensure alignment between innovation objectives, commercial priorities and IP strategy

**Patent Searching & Analytical Support**

* Design and execute sophisticated patent searches using a range of commercial and public databases.
* Conduct prior art, patentability, state-of-the-art, validity and invalidity searches.
* Analyse patent portfolios and competitor patent activity.
* Develop search methodologies and analytical frameworks to support complex research questions.
* Prepare clear reports and presentations communicating search findings and their commercial implications.

**Filing, Prosecution & Freedom-to-Operate Support**

* Support invention harvesting activities and facilitate invention disclosure generation across the innovation portfolio.
* Work directly with inventors and project teams to identify, capture and develop patentable inventions.
* Prepare patent application materials, invention summaries and supporting documentation for Patent Attorney review and filing.
* Support delivery of annual patent filing objectives through proactive identification and development of patent opportunities.
* Support the Patent Attorney in patent drafting, filing and prosecution activities as required.
* Conduct and support freedom-to-operate analyses and investigations.
* Assist with evidence gathering, prior art evaluation and technical analyses relevant to patent prosecution and portfolio management.
* Support ongoing portfolio reviews and maintenance activities.
* Contribute to IP risk assessments associated with research, development and commercialisation activities.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* The role will work across Legal and R&D, collaborating with a diverse network of stakeholders to provide timely and high-quality IP intelligence and support. Key stakeholders include:

**Legal**

* Patent Attorneys
* Members of the wider Legal and Intellectual Property teams

**Research & Development**

* Senior Directors, Platform Leads, Project Leads, Scientists, researchers and innovation teams.
* The successful candidate will be able to communicate complex IP concepts and analyses clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, influencing decisions through insight, evidence and sound judgement.

**Skills & Experience:**
**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Information Science, Library and Information Science, or another relevant scientific, technical or information management discipline.
* 5 - 7 years' experience in patent searching, patent information, IP intelligence or a related intellectual property role.
* Experience supporting front-end innovation, breakthrough innovation, technology development, technology scouting and/or early-stage R&D programmes.
* Demonstrated experience conducting patent landscapes, white space analyses and technology trend assessments.
* Experience supporting freedom-to-operate, patentability and prior-art analyses.
* Experience assessing patent portfolios and conducting IP due diligence.
* Proven ability to synthesise large and complex datasets into clear business-focused recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience applying information science principles and methodologies to the collection, organisation, analysis and synthesis of patent, scientific, technical and commercial information.
* Experience developing complex search strategies across multiple information domains and translating diverse datasets into actionable business intelligence.

**Preferred**

* Experience within FMCG, consumer health, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or broader life sciences sectors.
* Experience supporting external innovation, licensing, collaboration or technology acquisition activities.
* Experience working closely with patent attorneys, scientists and senior innovation leaders.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of patent systems, patent searching methodologies and intellectual property principles.
* Expertise in developing and executing advanced search strategies across multiple information sources.
* Strong analytical and information science capabilities, including data gathering, interrogation and synthesis.
* Knowledge of patent portfolio analysis, competitor intelligence and technology trend assessment.
* Understanding of freedom-to-operate considerations and patent lifecycle management.
* Strong grounding in information science principles, including information retrieval, search strategy design, taxonomy development, knowledge organisation, analytical methodologies and insight generation.
* Ability to integrate and synthesise information from patent, scientific, technical and commercial sources to support strategic decision-making.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-14
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Compliance Professional
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Description: Compliance Professional**
**Company:**
Siemens Healthineers
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore

Head of Compliance Zone India
