title: Regional Certification Liaison 1
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Product Compliance Engineer – Genset Compliance Management**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**Product Compliance Engineer**
to lead product safety and compliance management activities for generator set (Genset) products across countries in Rest of World (RoW - Europe, Middle-East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Australia-NZ and Latin America other than United States and Canada). This role is responsible for ensuring products meet all applicable regulatory, safety, and industry certification requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between the engineering organization and certification agencies in respective regions that could include UL, CSA, and other recognized certification and regulatory bodies, ensuring timely certification, maintenance of approvals, and resolution of compliance-related issues. The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Quality, and external agencies to support product development, certification, and market access objectives.
  
  
This position also requires periodic travel to test laboratories and certification facilities to witness product testing, support certification activities, and ensure compliance requirements are met. In addition, the role will be responsible for establishing and continuously improving compliance management processes and governance frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance Management**

* Manage regulatory and compliance requirements for generator set products marketed in countries other than the United States and Canada.
* Knowledgeable in applicable standards, codes, and regulations relevant to gensets and associated electrical systems.
* Ensure products maintain compliance including new product development, product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
* Monitor evolving regulatory and certification requirements and assess impact on products and business operations.

**Certification & Agency Management**

* Serve as the primary technical contact for certification agencies,

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Regulatory & Certification requirements covering the Machinery, EMC, RoHS & Noise Directives
+ Other certification, testing, and regulatory organizations as required

* Coordinate certification projects, audits, inspections, and follow-up activities.
* Manage certification documentation, test reports, technical files, and approval records.
* Drive timely closure of certification findings, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.

**Engineering Support**

* Provide compliance guidance to product development and engineering teams during design and development phases.
* Review product designs, drawings, specifications, and change requests for compliance impacts.
* Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to compliance issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into product designs.

**Regulatory Support & Consultation**

* Respond to compliance and regulatory inquiries from:

+ Engineering teams
+ Sales and commercial teams
+ Operations and manufacturing teams
+ Quality and service organizations

* Provide technical guidance on the application of standards and certification requirements.
* Support customer and regulatory compliance documentation requests.

**Testing & Validation**

* Coordinate compliance testing activities with internal teams and external laboratories.
* Develop test plans and compliance validation strategies.
* Travel to certification laboratories and test facilities to witness testing and represent the company during certification evaluations.
* Review and approve testing documentation and certification evidence.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance management processes, procedures, and governance models.
* Establish compliance metrics, reporting mechanisms, and tracking tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve compliance efficiency, reduce certification lead times, and improve product readiness.
* Support compliance training and awareness programs across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Generation, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred but not required.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in product compliance, certification, regulatory engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience with generator sets, power generation equipment, industrial electrical products, or similar engineered products preferred.
* Strong experience working with certification agencies and notified bodies for EU Regulatory certification. Working knowledge on RoHS, Outdoor Noise and other related EU Directives.
* Experience managing third-party testing and certification projects.
* Experience interpreting and applying Global product safety and compliance standards.

**Technical Skills (Top Skills Required)**
**Regulatory & Compliance Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of RoW product compliance requirements for electrical and power generation equipment.
* Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Certification Management**

* Experience coordinating certifications with:

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Notified Bodies
+ Africa & Middle-East regulatory agencies
+ Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTLs)
+ Certification and inspection bodies

**Product Safety Standards**

* Knowledge of applicable standards and codes, including:

+ UL standards
+ CSA standards
+ Electrical safety requirements
+ Applicable NFPA and industry requirements
+ Generator set and power system compliance requirements
+ All related ISO / IEC / EN Standards

**Product Development Support**

* Design review and compliance assessment capability.
* Engineering change impact assessment from a regulatory perspective.
* Risk assessment and compliance validation planning.

**Testing & Validation**

* Product certification testing coordination.
* Test plan development and execution.
* Test witnessing and compliance verification.

**Documentation & Compliance Systems**

* Technical documentation management.
* Certification file maintenance.
* Compliance records and audit preparation.
* Process development and governance documentation.

**Project Management**

* Managing multiple certification and compliance projects simultaneously.
* Planning, tracking, and reporting compliance activities.
* Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.

**Soft Skills**
**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities.

**Relationship Management**

* Ability to build effective working relationships with certification agencies, regulatory bodies, laboratories, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong customer-focused mindset when supporting internal and external compliance inquiries.

**Analytical Thinking**

* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to evaluate technical data and make sound compliance-related decisions.

**Attention to Detail**

* High level of accuracy in reviewing standards, certifications, test reports, and compliance documentation.
* Strong focus on quality and risk mitigation.

**Leadership & Influence**

* Ability to influence engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Drive compliance requirements effectively across cross-functional organizations.

**Adaptability**

* Ability to manage changing regulatory requirements and evolving business priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic product development environment.

**Collaboration**

* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and Sales organizations.

**Initiative & Ownership**

* Self-motivated with strong ownership of compliance deliverables.
* Ability to independently drive certification and compliance activities to successful completion.

**Travel Requirements**

* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Travel to certification laboratories, customer locations, manufacturing sites, and testing facilities to support compliance testing, certification activities, regulatory audits, and technical reviews.
* Estimated travel: 5-10%, depending on project and certification needs.

**Success Measures**
**The Product Compliance Engineer Will Be Successful When**

* Products achieve and maintain required certifications for countries in the regions other than US and Canadian markets.
* Compliance risks are proactively identified and mitigated.
* Certification projects are completed on schedule.
* Internal compliance inquiries are addressed accurately and promptly.
* Effective compliance processes and governance mechanisms are established and sustained.
* Strong working relationships are maintained with certification agencies and regulatory stakeholders.

title: GLOBAL TRADE SERVICES ANALYST II
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
TE Connectivity has built a world-class Global Trade Services (GTS) organization, including Operational Service Centers (OSCs) focused on delivering critical trade compliance services. This position is part of the Trade Jurisdiction & Classification Operational Service Center, which is responsible for supporting centralized activities associated with export and import jurisdiction and classification determinations across TE's global operations.
  
  
The
**Analyst, Trade Jurisdiction & Classification**
plays a key role in ensuring the timely and accurate assessment and classification of goods, software, technical information, and services for global trade compliance purposes. The successful candidate will support export control and customs classification activities across EMEA and other international jurisdictions, including the UK Strategic Export Control Lists, EU Dual-Use Regulations, India's SCOMET controls, Wassenaar Arrangement controls, and the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS).
  
  
This role joins a highly collaborative team of global trade professionals dedicated to enabling business growth through effective compliance solutions and trade risk management. The ideal candidate will thrive in a global environment, demonstrate strong integrity and accountability, and embrace collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. The role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to interpret complex technical and regulatory information, and a commitment to maintaining accurate and defensible trade classifications in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Assess and determine the jurisdiction and classification of goods, software, technical information, and services for export and import compliance purposes.
* Perform export control classifications under applicable regulations and control regimes, including UK Strategic Export Control Lists, EU Dual-Use Regulations, India's SCOMET controls, Wassenaar Arrangement controls, and other relevant international export control frameworks.
* Conduct customs tariff classifications using the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS) and applicable national tariff schedules.
* Interpret technical documentation, engineering specifications, and product information to support accurate and defensible trade classifications.
* Maintain classification records and supporting rationale in accordance with applicable regulatory and company requirements.

Additional Details
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Experience**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Law, Trade Compliance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years' experience in international trade compliance, with a primary focus on jurisdiction and classification activities.
* Demonstrated experience classifying products under export control regulations, including:

+ UK Strategic Export Control Lists
+ EU Dual-Use Regulation
+ SCOMET (Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies)
+ Wassenaar Arrangement-based controls and other international export control frameworks

* Demonstrated experience classifying products under the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS) and related customs tariff nomenclatures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate complex technical and regulatory information.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of U.S. export control regulations, including the U.S. Commerce Control List (CCL) and U.S. Munitions List (USML).
* Experience working within multinational manufacturing, industrial, technology, or electronics organizations.
* Familiarity with trade compliance software, product data management systems, and classification databases.
* Experience supporting automation, data management, or digital transformation initiatives within trade compliance.
* Understanding of global customs and export control regulations across multiple jurisdictions.

**Additional Competencies**
  
  

+ Strong understanding of the General Rules for Interpretation (GRIs), Harmonized System Explanatory Notes, and customs classification methodologies.
+ Ability to research, interpret, and apply multi-jurisdictional export control regulations and product classifications to complex technical products and technologies.

**About Te Connectivity**
TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.
  
  
Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).
  
  
**What Te Connectivity Offers**
We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* Performance-Based Bonus Plans
* Health and Wellness Incentives
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
* Employee Resource Group

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity
**never requests payment or fees**
from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come
**only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**
. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.
  
  
Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

description:

**Job Responsibilities**

* Conduct due diligence reviews of all suppliers, contractors, and service providers in accordance with Volvo Group Compliance Policies, Guidelines, and internal procedures.
* Verify relevant statutory registrations, licenses, certifications, compliance records, and supporting documentation.
* Identify compliance gaps and risks, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure timely closure of pending observations.
* Maintain proper records of due diligence reviews, approvals, and compliance assessments.

**Contractor Documentation & Statutory Registers**

* Ensure timely updating and maintenance of Form 12 (List of Contractors) and other applicable statutory records, as required under the relevant legislation.
* Ensure that Form 5 is issued to all eligible contractors promptly, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date contractor master data, statutory documentation, and compliance records.
* Monitor document validity and ensure timely renewal, submission, and record retention.

**Statutory Compliance Audits**

* Plan and conduct on-site statutory compliance audits of all service providers and contractors on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Verify compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory registrations, licence conditions, wage and employment records, social security contributions, and other relevant statutory obligations.
* Identify non-compliances, document audit findings, and prepare audit reports with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Follow up with service providers to ensure timely closure of audit observations and maintain evidence of compliance.

* Facilitate statutory inspections, document submissions, clarifications, and other regulatory requirements, as authorised.
* Ensure that all interactions and submissions are conducted transparently and in accordance with Volvo Group policies, guidelines, and applicable laws.

* Min. 3 years of relevant experience in statutory compliance, contractor compliance, labour law administration, contract management, or supplier compliance.
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial operations, or a large corporate environment will be preferred.
* Practical experience in statutory audits, contractor documentation, service agreements, and coordination with government authorities is desirable.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong working knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws and contractor-related statutory compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with contract drafting, review, execution, and document management.
* Strong analytical, audit, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and electronic document management systems.
* Excellent coordination, communication, follow-up, and stakeholder management skills.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, attention to detail, and professional conduct.
* Ability to manage multiple service providers, compliance deadlines, and audit requirements independently.

**Work Location**

* Hosakote, Karnataka. The position shall be based at the Hosakote facility and requires regular on-site coordination with contractors, service providers, internal departments, and relevant government authorities.

**Employment Type**
: Fixed-term employment.

title: Information Security Manager
description:
**Department:**

Security Governance and Management Department

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a strategic and experienced
**Information Security GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Manager**
to lead and mature our enterprise-wide GRC program across information security, data privacy, and telecommunications regulatory compliance. This role owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the GRC function — managing a team of specialists, driving risk-informed decision-making, and serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the CISO.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in security frameworks, regulatory landscapes, and telecom-specific compliance requirements, combined with the leadership capability to build high-performing teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders at all levels.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

**GRC Program Leadership**

* Own and drive the organization's GRC strategy, roadmap, and operating model across information security, data privacy, and telecommunications compliance.
* Build, lead, and mentor a team of GRC specialists, setting clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Report program health, risk posture, and compliance status to the CISO and senior leadership on a regular cadence.
* Define and track GRC program KPIs and OKRs (Key Performance Indicators / Objectives and Key Results), ensuring measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.

**Policy & Standards Governance**

* Oversee the lifecycle management of the organization's information security, privacy, and telecom compliance policy framework — including development, review, approval, and enforcement.
* Ensure policies and standards are aligned with applicable regulatory requirements, industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF), and business objectives.
* Establish governance processes to ensure consistent communication, acknowledgment, and enforcement of policies across all business units and personnel.

**Risk Management**

* Lead the enterprise information security risk management program, including periodic risk assessments, risk register maintenance, and risk treatment planning.
* Provide risk-based guidance to business and technology stakeholders, translating complex risk findings into clear, actionable recommendations for executive and operational audiences.
* Develop and maintain risk appetite and tolerance statements in alignment with organizational strategy, with particular attention to telecom-specific threat vectors (e.g., SS7/Diameter signaling, SIP/VoIP, BGP/DNS, mobile core).
* Oversee third-party and vendor risk management processes, ensuring supply chain risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated.

**Compliance & Audit Management**

* Manage the organization's compliance posture across applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 27001, GDPR, telecom-specific regulations, and other relevant frameworks.
* Direct and coordinate internal and external audit activities — including scoping, evidence collection, stakeholder preparation, and findings remediation.
* Oversee remediation tracking for audit findings and compliance gaps, ensuring timely closure with appropriate accountability.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for regulators, external auditors, and certification bodies on all GRC-related matters.

**Training & Security Awareness**

* Oversee the design and delivery of a role-based security awareness and compliance training program, ensuring coverage of telecom-specific regulatory obligations.
* Drive a culture of security and compliance awareness across the organization through targeted campaigns, metrics, and executive sponsorship.
* Measure training effectiveness and adjust programs based on outcomes and emerging risk areas.

**Incident & Crisis Governance**

* Provide GRC oversight for security, privacy, and telecom compliance incidents — ensuring regulatory notification obligations, documentation requirements, and post-incident review processes are met.
* Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal, state, and international privacy laws, telecommunications regulations, and accreditation standards.
* Collaborate with the Security Operations and Legal teams to ensure incident response plans reflect regulatory and contractual obligations.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Advisory**

* Act as a trusted advisor to the CISO, executive leadership, and the Board on matters of information security risk, compliance posture, and regulatory change.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, Product, Engineering, and Network Operations to embed GRC practices into business processes and technology delivery.
* Represent the GRC function in cross-functional governance forums, steering committees, and customer-facing engagements where security assurance is required.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Certifications
*(one or more preferred)***

* **CISM**
  (Certified Information Security Manager)
* **CISSP**
  (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* **CISA**
  (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* **CIPP**
  (Certified Information Privacy Professional)
* **ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor**
* Additional telecom or risk-focused certifications are a plus

**Experience**

* **Minimum 7–10 years**
  of progressive experience in information security, GRC, or a related field.
* **Minimum 3–5 years**
  in a people management or team leadership role, with demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
* Proven track record of designing and maturing GRC programs in complex, regulated environments — ideally within telecommunications, enterprise software, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Hands-on experience managing compliance programs against ISO 27001, GDPR, NIST CSF, and telecom-specific regulatory frameworks.
* Experience engaging with external auditors, regulators, and certification bodies.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate regulatory requirements and risk findings into business-aligned programs and roadmaps.
* **Leadership:**
  Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, and develop teams and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex risk and compliance topics clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* **Analytical rigor:**
  Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
* **Telecom domain knowledge:**
  Familiarity with telecom network security concepts, signaling protocols, and sector-specific regulatory obligations is highly desirable.

title: Sr. Manager - Paralegal
description:
**About**  
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.

Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.  
  
**Position Summary**

title: Manager, Hub - IP (Trademarks)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role**

  

The Manager, Hub - IP (Trademarks) will support Haleon’s global trademarks legal function by managing and coordinating trademark-related legal activities across the brand lifecycle. The role will partner closely with internal trademark attorneys, marketing, innovation, regulatory and business teams, and external counsel to support trademark clearance, filing, prosecution, portfolio management, enforcement coordination and legal risk assessment across multiple jurisdictions. The role requires strong trademark legal expertise, operational discipline, sound judgement, effective stakeholder management and consistently high attention to detail in a fast-paced global consumer healthcare environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Trademark Portfolio, Clearance & Risk Assessment**

* Support global trademark portfolio activities, including trademark clearance, filing coordination, prosecution tracking, renewals coordination and portfolio maintenance.
* Conduct and coordinate preliminary trademark searches, screening reviews and availability assessments in collaboration with internal and external counsel.
* Review, analyse and summarise trademark search reports, identifying potential legal or commercial risks for escalation to the relevant trademark attorney.
* Review trademark watch notices and determine which results require escalation to the relevant trademark attorney.

**Filings, Prosecution & Legal Documentation**

* Coordinate trademark filings, office action responses, oppositions, cancellations, coexistence matters and related prosecution activities with external counsel globally.
* Support the drafting, review and management of trademark-related legal documentation, including assignments, coexistence agreements, consent letters, powers of attorney, declarations and related filings.
* Monitor trademark deadlines, prosecution developments and portfolio status across jurisdictions, ensuring timely follow-up and escalation.
* Coordinate with external counsel on the implementation of trademark strategies, legal updates, filings and prosecution activities.

**Portfolio Governance, Records & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and complete trademark portfolio records, including thorough docketing and effective management of documentation and legal correspondence.
* Prepare trademark portfolio reports, status summaries, dashboards and legal updates for internal stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Support the development and maintenance of trademark legal templates, guidance notes, standard operating procedures, playbooks and internal knowledge resources.

**Enforcement, Transactions & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Support trademark enforcement and brand protection activities, including watch notice coordination, infringement escalations, online enforcement support and cease-and-desist coordination.
* Assist with trademark due diligence for acquisitions, divestitures, licensing arrangements, collaborations and corporate transactions, as required.
* Liaise with marketing, regulatory, business and other internal teams regarding brand name reviews, launch timelines, trademark risks and filing strategies.
Partner with global legal and business stakeholders to align trademark protection strategies with commercial objectives.  

  

**Qualifications & Skills:**

**Essential:**

* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) or equivalent legal qualification
* Additional certification or specialisation in intellectual property law or trademark practice would be advantageous.
* 6-8 years of relevant experience in trademark legal support, trademark prosecution, trademark portfolio management, or intellectual property legal or paralegal functions.
* Strong experience supporting global trademark portfolios within multinational corporations, law firms, consumer healthcare or FMCG organisations, or IP-focused legal teams.
* Experience coordinating trademark filings, oppositions, prosecution matters, enforcement support and portfolio maintenance activities across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience in trademark search analysis, risk assessment and trademark-related legal documentation support.
Prior experience in a shared services or GCC environment supporting global legal teams would be advantageous.  

  

**Preferred:**

* Strong legal and analytical thinking capability.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines in a fast-paced global environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound judgement and the ability to escalate legal risks and sensitive matters appropriately.
* Collaborative, practical and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across global teams and external counsel.
High degree of professionalism, confidentiality, accountability and ownership.  

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of global trademark prosecution and portfolio management processes.
* Familiarity with trademark lifecycle management, clearance processes, enforcement coordination and legal documentation management.
* Experience using trademark docketing or IP management systems, such as Anaqua or equivalent tools.
* Ability to review and interpret trademark search reports and identify legal risk considerations for escalation.
* Familiarity with trademark filing and prosecution processes across major jurisdictions, including the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and emerging markets.
* Strong legal drafting, documentation and contract review capability in relation to trademark matters.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience in legal reporting, portfolio tracking and records management is preferred.  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-27  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: UK EBP Supervisor
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Engagement Business Partner – Supervising Associate**
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As a senior Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
  
  

* Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
* Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
* Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
* Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
* Supporting the annual external audit process.

This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements, acting as the Finance single point of contact for the Engagement Partners with complex portfolios.
* Manage the professional development, coaching and upskilling of other EBPs in the team.
* Oversee team resourcing, proactively tracking joiners, leavers, and movers, and ensuring coverage of Partner portfolios during periods of leave or absence.
* Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:

+ Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
+ Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
+ Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
+ Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
+ Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
+ Support the portfolio’s working capital activity.

* Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
* Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
* Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
* Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
* Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
* Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
* Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
* Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
* Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
* Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
* Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
* Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
* Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
* Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
* Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
* Ability to lead others and support team development.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A minimum of two to three years’ experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
* Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
* Ability to lead others in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
* Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic.
* Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated, good communicators who can establish credibility with client servers and convey financial impacts in business language back to client servers. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in strengthening the team.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, including holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. In addition, you will benefit from:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll have access to EY’s world-class learning offerings, on-the-job coaching, and structured development programmes designed to deepen your expertise, broaden your perspective, and help you grow into the next stage of your career.
* Success as defined by you: Define what success looks like for you, and we’ll provide the tools and flexibility to help you achieve it.
* Transformative leadership: Gain the insights, coaching, and confidence to lead with purpose and impact.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**Please note:**
Prior to finalising your application, you will be asked to provide personal information across several dimensions of diversity and inclusiveness. The information you provide is kept entirely confidential and will not be used to evaluate your candidacy. We collect this data to help us analyse our recruitment process holistically and implement actions that promote diversity and inclusiveness. While optional, we encourage you to provide this information to hold us accountable towards our goal of building a better working world. Read more about our commitment to diversity & inclusiveness here. We ask because it matters!
